text:
ashley: Heads-up — Glacier (customer) reports p50 jump from ~45ms -> ~210ms for hosted text-generation in us-west-2. Started ~2026-03-15T12:09Z. Ticket GL-1123. Saw in telemetry + our edge logs. Anyone available?

devon: I'm oncall, looking. Can you paste a sample request + model name?

ashley: Sample request:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v2","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":32,"temperature":0.0}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Model: redwood-large-v2, seq_len target 64. Spike specifically for short-sync calls.

maria: Any deploys/rollouts around 11:50-12:10Z in us-west-2? :thinking: 

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to runtime v3.2.1 started 2026-03-15T11:58:23Z in us-west-2 (10% of traffic).

li: Running quick perf check against canary nodes. Can @devon run this from cloudjump? Command I used:
```
python infra/tools/bench_infer.py --model redwood-large-v2 --region us-west-2 --qps 5 --concurrency 4 --seq 64
```

devon: Ran that on a canary node. Results: p50 ~210ms, p95 ~320ms. GPU util ~54% (stable). Host CPU user ~30% but steal % spikes to 20-30% intermittently. Logs show kernel-selection falls back to 'generic-kernel' on 40% of steps. Posting profiler snapshot (short):
```
kv-cache: hit-rate 0.87
kernel_selector: fallback_ratio=0.42
cpu-steal[%]: 0, 2, 18, 25, 3, 0
```

maria: Interesting — fallback to generic kernels could explain slower ticks. Any recent kernel selector changes in v3.2.1? @ashley can you check PRs?

ashley: PR #4583 changed the kernel selector heuristic for chunked attention to be more conservative. Merged 2026-03-15T11:45Z (just before canary). Rolling back sounds reasonable.

devon: I'll initiate rollback of canary in us-west-2 to v3.2.0 now. Will monitor.

sre-bot: Incident CRIT-2026-45 opened for customer Glacier latency spike. Paging #eng-sre and #support.

li: While rollback's happening I'll collect more traces and dump kernel logs: `/var/log/runtime/kernel-selector.log` snippet shows increased 'fallback' entries starting 11:58Z.

ashley: Notifying Glacier support + PM. Ticket GL-1123 updated. Customer impact flagged.

maria: After rollback, please run the bench script and paste results here. If p50 returns to ~45ms, we isolate to selector change.

devon: Rollback complete at 2026-03-15T12:18Z. Post-rollback bench: p50 48ms, p95 82ms. :thumbsup: 

ashley: Great — confirmed rollback restores latency. Next steps: revert PR #4583 and add A/B test with feature flag + perf unit test in CI. I'll open a follow-up PR. Thanks all.

maria: I'll create a regression monitor alert for kernel-selector fallback ratio > 0.2 in prod.

devon: Closing loop with Glacier support. Will schedule deeper perf test to ensure no latent regressions.

ashley: Thanks team :heart:
